Package com.privatechain.core.model

Class Block

java.lang.Object
com.privatechain.core.model.Block
public final class Block extends Object
Immutable unit of the blockchain containing a list of transactions and a cryptographic link to the previous block (FR-CORE-01).

Every Block is self-contained: its hash is computed from the block's own fields (including previousHash and the Merkle root of its transactions) during construction and stored immutably. Tampering with any field of a block — or any transaction inside it — invalidates the hash, which in turn invalidates every subsequent block's previousHash link, making fraud detectable by Blockchain.isChainValid().

minerAddress is an optional field populated by consensus engines that need to identify which node produced a block (e.g. PoA, RoundRobin, PBFT). PoW blocks leave this field null since the producer is identified by hash effort alone.

Usage


 // PoW block (no miner address needed)
 Block block = Block.builder()
     .index(1)
     .previousHash(genesisBlock.getHash())
     .transactions(txList)
     .header(BlockHeader.builder().nonce(42L).build())
     .build();

 // PoA / RoundRobin / PBFT block (miner address required)
 Block block = Block.builder()
     .index(1)
     .previousHash(genesisBlock.getHash())
     .transactions(txList)
     .header(BlockHeader.builder().build())
     .minerAddress("0xABC...")
     .build();

1.0.0

  • Constructor Details

    • Block

      public Block(int index, BlockHeader header, String previousHash, String hash, List<Transaction> transactions, String minerAddress)
      Constructs a fully formed, immutable block.

      The hash parameter is stored as-is (not recomputed). New blocks should be created via Block.Builder.build() which computes the hash automatically.

      Parameters:
      index - block index (≥ 0)
      header - block header (non-null)
      previousHash - SHA-256 hex of the preceding block (non-null)
      hash - SHA-256 hex of this block (non-null)
      transactions - transactions in this block (non-null; may be empty)
      minerAddress - address of the producing node, or null for PoW blocks
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if indexed, header, previousHash, hash, or transactions is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if index is negative

  • Method Details

    • computeHash

      public static String computeHash(int index, String previousHash, BlockHeader header, String minerAddress)
      Computes the SHA-256 hash of a block from its constituent fields.

      The hash input is a deterministic canonical string formed by concatenating: index, previousHash, merkleRoot, timestamp, version, bits, nonce, and minerAddress. Including minerAddress in the hash ensures a block cannot claim a different producer without invalidating its hash.

      Parameters:
      index - block index
      previousHash - hex hash of the previous block
      header - block header (supplies nonce, Merkle root, etc.)
      minerAddress - producing node address; use "" when absent
      Returns:
      hex-encoded SHA-256 digest of the canonical input
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if SHA-256 is not available (unreachable on JDK 17+)

    • computeHash

      public static String computeHash(int index, String previousHash, BlockHeader header)
      Backwards-compatible overload that omits minerAddress.

      Delegates to computeHash(int, String, BlockHeader, String) with minerAddress = null. Preserved so existing callers in blockchain-core that do not supply a miner address compile without changes.

      Parameters:
      index - block index
      previousHash - hex hash of the previous block
      header - block header
      Returns:
      hex-encoded SHA-256 digest

    • getMinerAddress

      public String getMinerAddress()
      Returns the address of the node that produced this block, or null for PoW blocks where no identity claim is embedded.

      Used by identity-based consensus engines (ProofOfAuthorityEngine, RoundRobinEngine, PBFTEngine — all in blockchain-consensus) to validate that the block was produced by an authorized node.

      Returns:
      miner address string, or null

    • isHashValid

      public boolean isHashValid()
      Verifies that the stored hash matches a fresh computation.

      Used by Blockchain.isChainValid() and storage implementations after deserialization to detect corruption (NFR-SEC-03).

      Returns:
      true if the stored hash equals a freshly computed hash
